spans.s: नितंब m. 1. the buttocks, especially of a woman, the circumference of the hip and loins, नितंबबिंबैः सदुकूलमेखलैः Rt.i.4, Bhartr.i.5, R.iv.52, vi.17, Megh.i.41; 2. the ridge or side of a mountain, सेव्या नितंबाः किमु भूधराणां किंवा स्मरस्मेरविलासिनीनाम् Bhartr.i.19 (where the word is used in this sense and in sense 1), Bt.ii.8; 3. the sloping bank of a river; 4. the shoulder.
नितंब-बिंब n. round hips, Rt.i.4.
नितंब-वत् a. having beautiful hips.
नितंब-वती f. a woman.
नितंबिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Having beautiful hips, R.xix.26; 2. having beautiful sides.
नितंबिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Having beautiful hips, R.xix.26; 2. having beautiful sides.
नितंबिनी f. A woman with large and handsome hips, K.S.iii.7.
नितराम् ind. 1. Completely, entirely, Bhartr.i.96; 2. excessively, extremely, नितरां कृशासि Am.
, भवंति नितरां स्फीताः सिल्षेत्रे कंटकद्रुमाः Mrich.ix.; 3. always, continually, eternally; 4. at all events.
नितल n. One of the seven divisions of the lower regions.
नितांत a. (f. ता) Extraordinary, excessive, much, नितांतकठिनां रुजं मम न वेद सा मानसीम् Vikr.ii.(नितांतम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘excessively, exceedingly, in a high degree.’)
नितांत a. (f. ता) Extraordinary, excessive, much, नितांतकठिनां रुजं मम न वेद सा मानसीम् Vikr.ii.(नितांतम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘excessively, exceedingly, in a high degree.’)

नित्य (I) a. (f. त्या) 1. Continual, perpetual, constant, यत्रोन्मत्तभ्रमरमुखराः पादपा नित्यपुष्पा हंसश्रेणीरचितरशना नित्यपद्मा नलिन्यः । केकोत्कंठा भवनशिखिनो नित्यभास्वत्कलापा नित्यज्योत्स्नाः प्रतिहततमोवृत्तिरम्याः प्रदोषाः Megh.ii. (considered to be an interpolation by Mall.), M.ii.206; 2. invariable, regular, fixed, regularly prescribed, (op. to नैमित्तिक); 3. necessary, obligatory; 4. ordinary, usual, (op. to नैमित्तिक); 5. (at the end of a compound) constantly dwelling in or engaged in, e.g. अरण्यनित्य, तपोनित्य.
नित्य (II) m. The ocean.(नित्यम् is used adverbially in the sense of ‘daily, constantly, always, ever, perpetually,’ M.i.104.)

नित्य (I) a. (f. त्या) 1. Continual, perpetual, constant, यत्रोन्मत्तभ्रमरमुखराः पादपा नित्यपुष्पा हंसश्रेणीरचितरशना नित्यपद्मा नलिन्यः । केकोत्कंठा भवनशिखिनो नित्यभास्वत्कलापा नित्यज्योत्स्नाः प्रतिहततमोवृत्तिरम्याः प्रदोषाः Megh.ii. (considered to be an interpolation by Mall.), M.ii.206; 2. invariable, regular, fixed, regularly prescribed, (op. to नैमित्तिक); 3. necessary, obligatory; 4. ordinary, usual, (op. to नैमित्तिक); 5. (at the end of a compound) constantly dwelling in or engaged in, e.g. अरण्यनित्य, तपोनित्य.
नित्य-अनध्याय m. invariable suspension of Vedic study.
नित्य-अनित्य a. eternal and perishable.
नित्य-ऋतु a. regularly recurring at the seasons.
नित्य-कर्मन्, -कृत्य न्।, -क्रिया ऋ। n. a regular or necessary act or duty, a daily rite.
नित्य-कर्मन्, -कृत्य न्।, -क्रिया ऋ। n. a regular or necessary act or duty, a daily rite.
नित्य-क्रिया f. a regular or necessary act or duty, a daily rite.
नित्य-गति m. air, wind.
नित्य-दा ind. always, perpetually, eternally.
नित्य-दान n. daily alms-giving.
नित्य-नैमित्तिक n. any rite or ceremony constantly performed for the accomplishment of some object, (e.g. पर्वश्राद्ध).
नित्य-प्रलय m. sleep.
नित्य-मुक्त m. the supreme spirit.
नित्य-यौवना f. (ever youthful) an epithet of Draupadī.
नित्य-शंकित a. perpetually alarmed, always suspicious.
नित्य-शस् ind. always, constantly, eternally, Bg.viii.14, M.ii.96.
नित्य-समास m. a compound whose component parts cannot be used separately to convey its meaning (in gram.), e.g. जमदग्नि.
नीत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Conducted, led; 2. gained, obtained; 3. passed, passed away; 4. well-behaved, correct, (pp. of नी q.v.).
नीत (II) n. 1. Wealth; 2. corn, grain.
नीत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Conducted, led; 2. gained, obtained; 3. passed, passed away; 4. well-behaved, correct, (pp. of नी q.v.).

नीति f. 1. Guidance, direction, management; 2. conduct, behaviour; 3. acquirement, acquisition; 4. presenting, offering; 5. relation, support; 6. policy, statesmanship, K.S.i.22, R.xii.69; 7. political science, politics, Bg.x.38; 8. moral philosophy, ethics, precepts for prudent and moral behaviour.
नीति-कुशल, -ज्ञ, -निष्ण, -विद् m. a statesman, a politician.
नीति-कुशल, -ज्ञ, -निष्ण, -विद् m. a statesman, a politician.
नीति-कुशल, -ज्ञ, -निष्ण, -विद् m. a statesman, a politician.
नीति-कुशल, -ज्ञ, -निष्ण, -विद् m. a statesman, a politician.
नीति-घोष m. name of the car of Bṛhaspati.
नीति-दोष m. error of conduct, mistake in policy.
नीति-बीज n. a germ or source of intrigue.
नीति-विषय m. the sphere of morality or prudent conduct.
नीति-व्यतिक्रम m. transgression of the rules of moral or political science.
नीति-शास्त्र n. the science of ethics or of politics.
